All cores together

UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_Head: Cookie Slicer: what went wrong and how to fix it
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_Foot: Full details: Zomboid/console.txt (send it to an admin on Discord)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_unknown: The game could not finish loading
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_unknown_1: Close the game and join again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_unknown_2: Still the same: send Zomboid/console.txt to an admin on Discord
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_slow: Loading is taking longer than usual
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_slow_1: The first join after mod updates can take 3-5 minutes
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_slow_2: Over 10 minutes: close the game and join again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_ram: Not enough memory (RAM) for the game
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_ram_1: Close the game, run CookieSlicer-Setup and press 1 (sets the game RAM for your PC)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_ram_2: Close other programs that use a lot of RAM (browser, recording)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_pzopt: PZ Optimization is still in the game (it breaks after game updates)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_pzopt_1: Close the game, run CookieSlicer-Setup and press 1 (repairs ProjectZomboid64.json)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_pzopt_2: Or Steam: Project Zomboid > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_workshop: A mod on your PC is not the server's version
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_workshop_1: Close the game and restart Steam so it updates the mods (see Downloads)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_workshop_2: Still the same: Unsubscribe that item and Subscribe again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_workshop_3: Everyone has it: ask an admin to restart the server
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_modmissing: A mod the server needs is not installed
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_modmissing_1: Subscribe to it on the Workshop, wait for Steam, then join again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_map: A map the server uses is not installed
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_map_1: Subscribe to the server's map mods on the Workshop, then join again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_files: Game or mod files on your PC do not match the server
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_files_1: Remove mod folders you copied yourself into Zomboid/mods (same names as the server's)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_files_2: Steam: Verify integrity of game files
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_files_3: Unsubscribe and Subscribe the server's mods again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_version: Your game version is not the server's
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_version_1: Let Steam update the game; do not use a beta branch
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_banned: This account is banned on the server
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_already: This account is still connected on the server
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_access: Not allowed in (not on the whitelist yet, or wrong name / password)
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_access_1: Check the name and password the admins gave you
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_access_2: Ask for the whitelist on Discord
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_full_1: Wait a moment and join again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_ping: Your ping is above the server's limit
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_ping_1: Stop downloads / streams, use a cable instead of Wi-Fi
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_net: The connection to the server was lost
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_net_1: Check your internet, turn off VPN
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_net_2: Check Discord: the server may be restarting
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_luamod_1: Unsubscribe and Subscribe that mod again
UI_CookieSlicer_Fix_luamod_2: Still the same: send Zomboid/console.txt to an admin on Discord
